description: Run the 5 center pivots, the pump station, the watermelon drip zones, and fertigation; respond to pivot and pump alarms; record flow for the water use permit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Watermelons on plastic mulch in May and June can lose fruit set and size after a day without water in hot, dry weather; a misbehaving fertigation pump can burn a crop or expose workers to chemicals; pivots and pumps can be run by hand, but only the Irrigation and Equipment Technician knows how and the River Tract is 9 miles away
manual_workaround: Hand operation at each pivot panel and the pump station (Hand-Off-Auto switches); fertigation off until automation is trusted; flow read from meter faces; written procedure to be created (POAM-004)
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (irrigation module); SYS-05; SYS-04 (pump station link); SYS-03 (phones)
dependent_third_parties: Pivot manufacturer connectivity service (through SYS-01); irrigation dealer; cellular carrier; electric utility
dependent_people_or_facilities: Irrigation and Equipment Technician (single point of knowledge); pump station; pivots

description: Schedule harvest with the packer-shipper; record field, date, and load numbers for each truck; confirm committed loads
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $9,000 of receipts per harvest day in the 8-week season; ripe watermelons cannot wait more than a day or two; the grower agreement requires 24-hour notice of anything affecting traceability or committed loads; field and load records support the packer-shipper's traceability
manual_workaround: Paper harvest log and load tickets; phone the packer-shipper's field buyer; key the paper log into SYS-01 within 2 days
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-03 (field tablet and phones); SYS-02 (email to the packer-shipper)
dependent_third_parties: Packer-shipper; contracted harvest crew arranged by the packer-shipper; cellular carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner and General Manager; Field Supervisor

business_process: Daily hours and Produce Safety records
description: Enter each worker's daily hours offered and worked and start and end times; enter harvest, cleaning, agricultural water, and training records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily hours are part of the H-2A earnings record (20 CFR 655.122(j)(1)) and the basis of pay; Produce Safety records must be created at the time of the activity (21 CFR 112.161(a)(2)) and kept 2 years (112.164(a)(1)); lost entries cannot be honestly re-created
manual_workaround: Paper daily hours sheets and paper Produce Safety forms signed by the person who did the work; keyed into SYS-01 when restored, with the paper kept as the original

business_process: Peanut and cotton harvest and delivery
description: Dig, combine, and pick; deliver peanuts to the buying point and cotton modules to the gin; track deliveries and grade sheets
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Peanuts must be combined within days of digging; the buying point and gin issue their own receipts, so the farm's copy can be rebuilt from theirs
manual_workaround: Paper delivery log; buying point and gin receipts; harvest by guidance lines already stored on the displays
dependent_third_parties: Buying point; cooperative gin; equipment dealer
dependent_people_or_facilities: Equipment Operator; Irrigation and Equipment Technician

description: Planting, spraying, and fertilizing with GNSS guidance and section control; chemical application records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Planting and spray windows are a few days; application records are required for pesticide recordkeeping and kept in SYS-01; as-applied maps stay on the machine displays for a week and can be re-synced
manual_workaround: Manual steering with foam markers; paper application records; re-sync as-applied data from the displays
dependent_people_or_facilities: Equipment Operator; Irrigation and Equipment Technician

description: Weekly payroll through the payroll service; H-2A earnings statements; onboarding and termination; H-2A filings with the filing agent
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: H-2A workers must receive an earnings statement on or before each payday (20 CFR 655.122(k)); records must be kept 3 years (655.122(j)(4)) and made available within 72 hours of a request when kept at a central office (655.122(j)(2)); late pay harms workers
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior week's payroll through the payroll service and correct the next week from paper hours; payroll service portal from any clean device
dependent_systems: SYS-10; SYS-02 (Office folder); SYS-03 (office desktop); SYS-08
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; H-2A filing agent; MSP

business_process: Accounting, USDA programs, crop insurance, and water use reporting
description: Bills, invoices, bank reconciliation; FSA acreage reports; crop insurance production reports; annual water use report
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are set by the agencies, the insurance agent, and the water management district at known points in the year; production evidence comes from buying point and gin records
manual_workaround: Bank portal and accounting SaaS from any clean device; agent and agency offices accept paper
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; CPA firm; crop insurance agent
dependent_people_or_facilities: Office Manager; Owner and General Manager

business_process: Crop scouting, drone imagery, and yield forecasting
description: Weekly drone flights; upload imagery; yield estimates for load commitments and crew planning (AI-001 pilot)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly planning cycle; estimates are advisory; the Owner and General Manager can plan from field counts as before the pilot
manual_workaround: Field walk and hand counts on sample rows
